ver: One of the most dominant and unstoppable talents in Formula 1 history. Max combines an aggressive driving style, always on the edge of physics, with surgical precision and machine-like race management. In 2026 he takes on the technical revolution by carrying the ambitious Red Bull Powertrains project, built in partnership with Ford: an engineering gamble that will define the next chapter of his career. Out of the cockpit his obsession with competition never switches off: he is a professional sim racer for Team Redline. It is not unusual to see him fighting and winning gruelling virtual races late at night, even on the simulator installed on his private jet, just hours before stepping onto a real track and dominating a Grand Prix. Blunt, direct and completely immune to pressure.
lec: 'The Chosen One', undisputed idol of Maranello and standard-bearer of Scuderia Ferrari's title dream. Charles is known worldwide for his stunning raw pace and a natural one-lap talent with few equals in recent history. The 2026 season puts him at the heart of the most explosive and fascinating pairing on the grid, sharing the garage with Lewis Hamilton under Fred Vasseur's leadership. Away from the noise of the circuits Leclerc has a deeply artistic soul: he is an excellent pianist and composer, and has released several very successful instrumental classical pieces on Spotify. A fan of fashion, sailing and diving, he often travels with his puppy Leo, who quickly became the paddock's unofficial mascot and a favourite of the Tifosi.
ham: A true living legend of motorsport. The seven-time world champion shook the sport to its foundations with his historic move to Ferrari, bringing to Maranello an invaluable wealth of charisma, technical experience and the fierce hunger needed to chase an eighth world title, a milestone that would make him the most successful driver ever. Beyond being an absolute icon on track, Sir Lewis is a global activist fighting for diversity in motorsport through his Mission 44 foundation. A high-fashion icon and Hollywood film producer, he follows a strictly vegan diet and loves extreme sports: he spends the off-season surfing with world champions and skydiving regularly.
nor: Innate speed, pure talent and a work ethic that turned him from a young prospect into a ruthless top driver. Lando has established himself as McLaren's leading man, ready to exploit the 2026 regulations to cement his status as a genuine title contender. Hugely popular with Gen Z for his genuine personality and self-deprecating streak, off track he is a successful entrepreneur: he founded 'Quadrant', a global brand that blends gaming, lifestyle and sportswear. When he is not in the Woking simulator he is a keen and competitive golfer (often in endless duels with his friend Carlos Sainz), an enthusiastic amateur photographer and an occasional DJ at paddock parties.
sai: Universally known as the 'Smooth Operator'. Carlos pairs deadly consistency with the tactical intelligence of a chief engineer, qualities that made him James Vowles' perfect choice to lead Williams' ambitious revival in the 2026 engine era. The son of legendary rally world champion Carlos Sainz Sr., he inherited from his father an extraordinary technical sensitivity for car development. Out of the cockpit he is a passionate Real Madrid fan, a remarkably talented golfer and a lover of good food and Spanish traditions. He is known as one of the most methodical drivers on the grid: his pre-race routines and physical training are planned down to the smallest detail.
pia: Nicknamed 'The Iceman' for his temperament. Cold, calculating and totally immune to pressure, Oscar showed a veteran's maturity from his very first kilometres in F1, rushing through the stages and quickly becoming a serious race-winning contender with McLaren. His surgical tyre management and clean driving make him ideal for the complex aerodynamics of the 2026 cars. Under the wing of his manager Mark Webber he has developed a killer instinct. Off track, though, his ultra-dry and cutting humour on social media has become a cult favourite with fans. A huge sports fan, he closely follows cricket and supports the Richmond Tigers in Australian football.
rus: Technical and extremely clean driving, yet capable of fierce aggression in wheel-to-wheel battles. With Hamilton gone, George has fully taken on the role of captain and undisputed leader of the Mercedes garage, steering development to get the most out of the brand-new 2026 engine. As a director of the GPDA, the drivers' association, he is the political voice of the grid. His work ethic is legendary: he famously convinced Toto Wolff to sign him as a teenager by showing up with a detailed PowerPoint dossier on his strengths. Off track he loves British fashion and engineering precision, and keeps fit with intense padel matches and cycling in the hills above Monaco.
alo: The indestructible veteran, the eternal samurai of the grid. Fernando openly defies biology as he leads Aston Martin into the revolutionary era of the 2026 Honda engine. He takes on this epic transition, and the return of the Japanese manufacturer, with the fierce drive of a rookie and an unrivalled strategic reading of races. A superior analytical mind, he is a master of psychological games with his rivals. His endless love for motorsport led him to found the A14 Management agency to nurture young talent (including Gabriel Bortoleto), and he owns a karting circuit with a museum in Asturias. When he relaxes in the garage he loves to amaze his mechanics and engineers with elaborate card tricks.
ant: The brilliant and eagerly awaited face of Italy's new generation in world motorsport. Kimi (registered as Andrea Kimi Antonelli) jumped straight from the junior categories into the hottest seat in Formula 1: the Mercedes left free by his idol Lewis Hamilton. He has handled enormous global media pressure with disarming calm, backed by a crystal-clear talent followed and shaped by Toto Wolff since he was just 11. Raised in Bologna in a family that lives and breathes engines (his father owns a racing team), he has an incredibly instinctive driving style that adapts beautifully to the wet. Despite the global spotlight he stays humble and loves spending time on the simulator and going out with his childhood friends.
alb: Resilience and rebirth in driver form. Alex masterfully rebuilt his career after difficult years, becoming the undisputed leader and cornerstone of Williams. In 2026 he partners Carlos Sainz in one of the most balanced, experienced and tactically smart line-ups in the championship, with the goal of bringing the historic British team back to the podium. Much loved in the paddock for his sunny character, he excels at reading strategy and nursing his tyres to the extreme. Away from the track he turned his home into a farm: his family runs a hugely popular Instagram account, 'Albon Pets', devoted entirely to their many animals. He is also a passionate collector of limited-edition sneakers.
gas: Fast, charismatic and consistently solid when the stopwatch really matters. Pierre is the face and anchor of the Alpine project, tasked with leading the French team through a deep and complex technical overhaul ahead of 2026. He has shown enviable tenacity, often emerging as the standout of the midfield with heroic drives and unexpected podiums. He shares a deep, long and brotherly friendship with Charles Leclerc that began banging wheels in karts as children, and always races with the memory of his friend Anthoine Hubert in his heart. A shrewd entrepreneur, he has invested in football (becoming co-owner of FC Versailles) and in technology. He is a die-hard Paris Saint-Germain fan and a formidable Call of Duty player.
oco: A driver with a steely character, known for a very hard-nosed style and an impenetrable defence in close fights. Esteban has opened an exciting new chapter of his career by joining the American Haas team for the 2026 era, bringing to Kannapolis a valuable store of experience gained with works teams. His story is a hymn to sacrifice: he comes from a humble family that sold their home and lived in a caravan to fund his early karting years. Off track Esteban is a passionate, self-confessed nerd: he loves Japanese pop culture, collects manga, builds elaborate motorsport-themed LEGO sets and spends hours on complex flight simulators and Gran Turismo.
hul: The master of technical precision, the man of perfect qualifying laps in the wet. Nico puts his vast veteran experience entirely at the service of Audi's new, huge and ambitious works project in Formula 1. Mattia Binotto wanted him to develop the new German power unit and lead the 2026 transition. He holds the unusual record for the most Grands Prix started without ever reaching the podium, a bitter statistic he hopes to finally shatter with the resources of the four-ring giant. Affectionately nicknamed 'Hülkenback' for his remarkable last-minute stand-in drives over the years, Nico is appreciated for his dry and sharp German humour. In his free time he is a skilled tennis player and loves interior design.
per: Known worldwide as the 'King of street circuits' for his extraordinary ability to brush the walls at three hundred km/h without a single mistake. Sergio 'Checo' Pérez brings more than a decade of experience to the track, especially in the microscopic management of rear tyres under heavy degradation. In his native Mexico he is a genuine national hero, with an ocean of fans who bring the streets to a standstill and pack the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez to the rafters. A devoted family man, Checo is a central figure for the Latin American market. Away from the deafening noise of F1 he retreats to his beloved Guadalajara; he is a demanding collector of fine watches, a fervent football fan and a very good golfer.
tsu: Growing year after year, Yuki has evolved from an error-prone rookie into a rock-solid, lightning-fast driver and a technical beacon for Racing Bulls. He combines the grit and honour of the Japanese school with a close and fruitful bond with Honda's engineers. Famous for his explosive team radios and his complete lack of a filter, he has become one of the fans' favourite characters worldwide. But his real obsession, besides speed, is fine dining: he has said many times that his biggest dream outside F1 is to open and run a top-level gourmet restaurant. In his free time he trains hard, cooks Michelin-worthy dishes and plays Apex Legends.
law: New Zealand grit, lightning reflexes and an uncompromising approach to racing. Liam earned his Formula 1 seat through bold moves and big performances delivered in full emergency mode, showing the world he is not afraid to go toe to toe with multiple world champions. Alongside his undoubted pace he brings strong tactical intelligence. Deeply proud of his roots, he carries traditional Maori symbols on his helmet and is an inspirational figure in New Zealand. A natural communicator, he is a keen vlogger who loves documenting the raw reality and behind-the-scenes life of a driver on social media. A hardcore sim racer, he spends much of his free time training virtually or honing his rally skills.
bea: The jewel of the Ferrari Driver Academy. Oliver, 'Ollie' to everyone, forced his way into F1 history by scoring world championship points on his sudden debut in Jeddah, called up at the last second to replace Sainz. That remarkable feat earned him a full-time seat at Haas. British, from Chelmsford, he pairs a very polite and calm manner out of the car with a predatory instinct as soon as the visor comes down. As one of the youngest drivers ever to hold a regular seat on the grid, he is handling international fame with surprising maturity. He keeps a very strict and private lifestyle, spending huge amounts of time in the Maranello simulator to refine his feel for the 2026 power units.
bor: The rising star of South American motorsport who brought Brazil back to the starting grid. Gabriel Bortoleto reached the top tier as Audi-Sauber's pick, carrying the Formula 3 title he won as a rookie and stunning natural talent. His career is managed directly by Fernando Alonso through A14 Management: the Spaniard took him under his wing, passing on tactical secrets and race craft. Gabriel is adored at home, where he is seen as the spiritual heir to Brazil's great racing tradition. Extremely analytical and calculating with telemetry, he also broke through in the media thanks to his strong online presence, as a pioneer of Brazilian competitive sim racing and a popular streamer on Twitch.
doo: Pure talent, an unbreakable work ethic and Australian composure. Jack Doohan earned Alpine's race seat for the 2026 era after impressing the engineers by piling up thousands of kilometres in private testing and long nights on the simulator, showing a technical development ability rare for his age. Although he is the son of motorcycle racing legend Mick Doohan, five-time 500cc world champion, Jack chose four wheels from a very young age, guided and encouraged by family friend Michael Schumacher. An old-school character with total dedication to fitness, he has an impressive mechanical understanding of the car. Back home on his beloved Gold Coast he spends all his free time surfing big waves.
col: The shooting star who reignited the passion for Formula 1 across Argentina and South America. Franco Colapinto charmed fans worldwide from his very first appearance, with breathtaking overtakes, raw speed and bold courage against the veterans. His media impact was a tsunami: backed by major sponsors and a fanbase of millions that floods the circuits, he shook up the driver market. With his relaxed, witty and magnetic personality he won over the paddock and TV audiences around the world. A devoted Boca Juniors fan who never parts with his traditional mate, he is the perfect, romantic underdog success story.
bot: A blend of elite experience, consistency and an unmistakable zen mindset. Valtteri brings his vast mechanical knowledge and the surgical feedback honed in Mercedes' golden years to the development of the new 2026 cars. Free from the suffocating pressure of a title fight, he has completely reinvented his public image and become a true cult hero of the paddock: iconic mullet, 80s moustache and brilliant self-irony. A versatile athlete with an impressive VO2 max, he is a high-level cyclist who regularly takes part in gruelling international gravel races with his partner. Famous for his cheeky charity calendars, he is a coffee connoisseur and producer with his own Finnish roastery.
str: An incredibly solid driver capable of exceptional highs and stunning performances, especially when conditions turn extreme, in torrential rain or on tracks that demand huge courage. Lance tackles the very demanding 2026 season with Aston Martin, at the heart of the brand-new, futuristic technology campus at Silverstone under the brilliant direction of Adrian Newey. Often criticised for his family background, he answers on track with commendable tenacity and precise recovery drives. A very private man who dislikes the spotlight outside race weekends, he loves North American winter sports: he is a skilled extreme off-piste skier, a big ice hockey fan and player, and a mountain bike enthusiast.
default: A professional driver in the FIA Formula 1 World Championship, ready to take on the revolutionary technical era of the 2026 season. These elite athletes are the absolute peak of global motorsport. They must tame hybrid power units producing more than 1000 horsepower on 100% sustainable fuel, while managing the complex flows of active aerodynamics at over 340 km/h. Beyond pure talent, courage and reflexes at the edge of human limits, modern Formula 1 demands extreme physical preparation to withstand lateral G-forces that can exceed 5G in corners for almost two hours, while staying sharp enough to make key strategic decisions in fractions of a second, in constant contact with the pit wall.
